cards.public_summary: Jeremy Fowler reported that Jaxson Dart is not expected to play in the preseason finale against the Jets.
cards.evidence: This week was no different in terms of whether he planned to play his starters. If ESPN reporter Jeremy Fowler’s sources are correct, Harbaugh has decided against playing starting quarterback Jaxson Dart in the preseason finale against the Jets.
cards.commentary: Dart appears set to sit out the finale, so there will be no final preseason playing-time data from this game. This does not establish a regular-season role change; confirmation from the team would strengthen it.
cards.author: Patricia Traina
cards.model_original_commentary: Dart appears set to sit out the finale, so there will be no final preseason playing-time data from this game. This does not establish a regular-season role change; confirmation from the team would strengthen it.
draft_limitations: The report is attributed to Jeremy Fowler's sources rather than an official team announcement.
The evidence does not state why Dart will sit or indicate any injury.
Sitting a preseason finale does not by itself confirm a regular-season depth-chart role.

cards.public_summary: David Furones reported Quinn Ewers will miss the game with a groin issue and will not be available behind Malik Willis.
cards.evidence: Quinn Ewers (groin) is indeed not in uniform for pregame warmups, as @CameronWolfe reported he won't go either behind Malik Willis.
cards.commentary: Willis appears positioned to handle the available quarterback role with Ewers out. Monitor whether Miami confirms Willis as the starter and whether Ewers' absence extends beyond this game.
cards.author: DavidFurones_
